quaere: Target frontier-lab applied roles at remote-friendly companies, with a secondary focus on data-platform roles that can be performed from India. Their demand clusters around Python, customer discovery, travel, demos, and translating business needs into architecture, so production Python and evaluation skills unlock the broadest near-term fit. The ranking reflects scarce evidence of readiness and limited local accessibility, not weak market prospects. Build proof through production Python architecture and evaluation infrastructure, while using discovery, demos, and stakeholder work as visible differentiators.
